evals.name: natural-korean-memory
evals.prompt: 이 프로젝트는 pnpm을 쓰고, 답변은 한국어로 짧게 하는 걸 선호해. 다음 세션에서도 기억하도록 각각 저장해줘. 저장됐는지 ‘pnpm’, ‘답변’으로 찾아서 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: Two concise ring1 facts saved in the user's project, both successfully recalled, with a short Korean confirmation.
assertions: The project DB contains a ring1 fact that the project uses pnpm.
A separate ring1 fact preserves both Korean language and short-answer preferences.
Both requested facts were actually recalled, as shown by their persisted access counts.
The final Korean response confirms successful storage and retrieval concisely.

evals.name: kernel-proposal-and-history
evals.prompt: 에이전트 이름을 Ring으로 ring0에 등록하고 싶어. 아직 승인은 안 할 테니 제안만 만들어줘. 그리고 기존 기억에 중복된 배포 기록이 있는데, 내용과 이력은 남기면서 정리하고 결과를 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: A pending proposal with no active ring0 write; duplicate deployment entries consolidated without physically deleting any memory; short Korean result distinguishing proposal from approval.
assertions: An unapproved proposal for the name Ring is pending and ring0 remains empty.
Both original deployment memory IDs and their content remain in the database.
Only one deployment record remains active in ring2 after consolidation.
The final Korean response distinguishes pending approval from applied memory, explains retained history, and stays under 500 characters.
